scope: Retained Phase 4/5 production snapshots; no new external query during final integration

egs.processing: Class vectors to EPSG:32610; pixel-center rasterization on 20 m grid; exported vectorized masks
egs.reference_definition: Fixed OBS01 semantic class 1, not observed pre-event normal water

hydrology.meaning: Regional discharge/water-level context, not water temperature or pixel truth
hydrology.approval_field: Original approval/status preserved; selected unit values report Final/Finales
hydrology.distance_note: Stored station-to-AOI distances are contextual rounded values, not surveyed distances
hydrology.retrieval_time: Exact HTTP retrieval timestamp not retained; do not infer it from event dates

osm.resolved_endpoint: Not retained in the cached response; do not infer which endpoint succeeded
osm.query_meaning: ways tagged highway in WGS84 AOI envelope, clipped to exact EPSG:32610 AOI
osm.retrieval_note: Evidence table records 2026-10-03; OSM base timestamp is not HTTP retrieval time

alr.meaning: OBS01 gain/ALR designation intersection only, not full ALR AOI area, crop acreage or damage

communities.scope: 25 retained nearest named points, not settlement boundaries or population inventory

priority_grid.source: Deterministic fixed UTM grid in Phase 4/5 notebooks
priority_grid.boundary_cells: Nominal squares may extend outside AOI; coverage denominator is valid AOI pixels

compatibility: Existing baseline-named CSV columns and human-readable GeoJSON UTC labels retained; meanings are defined in handoff impact_contract
